reasoning: Every invalid four-point set has a unique line containing at least three of its points. For a line with k selected points subtract C(k,3)*(N-k)+C(k,4). Enumerate vertical/horizontal lines directly. For other lines enumerate primitive signed direction (dx,dy) with at least three lattice positions inside the bounding box; start only at positions whose predecessor is outside the box. This visits each possible offending line exactly once. Directions with either displacement exceeding half the corresponding box dimension cannot contain three points and need not be visited. Integer geometry avoids tolerance errors.
